requirements.summary: Update Admin Access Management UI text to reflect that any admin (not just the owner) can grant/revoke admin access.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAccessSection.tsx, the description text "Owner-only: Grant or revoke admin access" is changed to English wording that indicates admins can grant/revoke admin access.

No functionality regressions in the Admin Access section: listing admin emails, granting access, and revoking access still use the existing hooks (useListAdminEmails/useGrantAdminAccess/useRevokeAdminAccess).

file_operations.description: Replace the owner-only description copy under "Admin Access Management" with English wording indicating that any admin can grant/revoke admin access (keeping all existing functionality and hook usage unchanged).
